examples.title: Quarterly research brief from scattered evidence
examples.workspace: Mixed documents, tables, notes, and archived references
examples.instruction: Prepare a concise decision brief by locating the relevant source files, resolving conflicting figures, and citing the final evidence chain.
examples.hiddenDependencies: Important assumptions appear in a dated note and a spreadsheet comment, not in the top-level README.
examples.deliverable: Brief with reconciled metrics, source citations, and caveats.

examples.title: Workspace cleanup with policy constraints
examples.workspace: Nested directories with duplicated files, policy docs, and logs
examples.instruction: Identify obsolete files, preserve regulated records, and produce a cleanup manifest.
examples.hiddenDependencies: Several files look duplicated but are retained because an audit log references them.
examples.deliverable: Cleanup manifest with keep/delete decisions and rationale.

examples.title: Cross-file data quality investigation
examples.workspace: CSV files, schema notes, validation reports, and dashboards
examples.instruction: Find why the dashboard total diverges from the source exports and propose the correction.
examples.hiddenDependencies: The mismatch depends on a column rename documented only in a migration note.
examples.deliverable: Diagnosis, corrected aggregation rule, and updated validation summary.

examples.title: Multi-file content package update
examples.workspace: Drafts, asset metadata, style guide, and release checklist
examples.instruction: Update a content package so that copy, asset references, and release checklist are consistent.
examples.hiddenDependencies: The current asset version is encoded in metadata and not visible in filenames.
examples.deliverable: Updated package summary with all changed references.
